description: This Java source file defines a Spring Shell component for managing MockKeypad devices, including listing, adding, tampering, and setting battery states for keypads in a testing environment.

classes.name: KeypadDeviceShell
classes.description: A Spring Shell component class that provides command-line interface methods to manage MockKeypad devices, such as listing, adding, tampering, and battery status toggling.

classes.name: NameValueProvider
classes.description: A nested static class extending DeviceNameProvider to supply device names for MockKeypad devices within shell commands.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all existing keypads in a table format.

methods.name: addKeypad
methods.description: Adds a new keypad with a specified name or a default sequential name.

methods.name: tamper
methods.description: Sets the specified keypad's state as tampered.

methods.name: tamperRestore
methods.description: Restores the specified keypad's tamper state to normal.

methods.name: tamperToggle
methods.description: Toggles the tampered state of the specified keypad.

methods.name: lowBattery
methods.description: Marks the specified keypad as having low battery.

methods.name: lowBatteryRestore
methods.description: Restores the specified keypad's battery state from low to normal.

methods.name: lowBatteryToggle
methods.description: Toggles the low battery status of the specified keypad.
